project_type: Next.js App Router personal academic portfolio and MDX blog
summary: A partially customized Tailwind Next.js Starter Blog site for Jie Dean Zhong, with a custom profile homepage, research/news/blog routes, Contentlayer MDX content, and GitHub Pages static export.
current_status: Partial customization; source inspected only. Local build, lint, and deployment are unverified. Working tree had a pre-existing modified next-env.d.ts before this transfer package.
main_goals: Present Jie Dean Zhong's academic profile and research interests
Publish research/project cards and news updates
Host MDX blog posts with tags, search, RSS, and static assets
Deploy a static export to GitHub Pages
